purpose: Exact authored-lesson inventory for Ready for Life and Financial Literacy, derived from source, plus the reasons full production coverage is not certifiable today.
stageDistinction: Grades 9-12 are AUTHORED (432 lessons at curriculum-authoring/full-family-highschool-9-12 on mac/hs912-rfl-finlit-r1) but NOT promoted into any curriculum-content release. A scan restricted to curriculum-content/ misses them and wrongly reads as 'no HS curriculum exists'.

existingSliceCoverage.answerKeyAudit: All 12 shipped FinLit scoring records carry distinct, recomputed fixed answer keys. The shipped slice is genuinely authored; the gate blind spot is a scaling risk, not a defect in these 24.

blockers.highSchoolUnreleased: No ref promotes grade 9-12 into a curriculum-content release and version 1.1.0 has never existed. Building shipping student work against curriculum-authoring/ would pin 432 lessons of production material to an unreleased source. Sequencing decision, not a content gap.
blockers.grade09ProvenanceCitesWrongPath: The four shipped grade-09-hs packages declare sourceCorpusVersion 1.1.0 and corpus-manifest.json names a nonexistent curriculum-content/1.1.0 path. All four cited lesson IDs DO resolve in curriculum-authoring/full-family-highschool-9-12, so this is a wrong-path citation, not invented material. Fix the path and version.
blockers.sourceCarriesNoAnswerContent: In released 1.0.0 courses answer_or_scoring_guidance, materials, mastery_rule and safety_and_privacy are byte-identical across every lesson and the scoring string has no digits; the genuine per-lesson payload is the focus phrase. Across all 432 HS lessons the guidance contains no currency amount and no computation. So 216 released (504 including HS) FinLit answer keys must each be authored and independently verified.
blockers.gateCannotDetectThis: For MATH_STRUCTURED_FINLIT the gate checks only kind==='ANSWER_KEY' and isSubstantive(content); isSubstantive never reads text, and the specificity heuristic is applied to instruction/workedExample/guidedPractice/independentWork and to nothing else. Generic boilerplate, 'TODO', wrong arithmetic, an empty string, and a text-less block all return READY with zero notes.
blockers.attestationNotWiredAtRuntime: computeCompletionStatus has no caller anywhere in src/. The guarantee that a learner click cannot certify a guardian-supervised task is proven about a pure function the product does not invoke. Close before any guardian-authority lesson reaches a household.

whatFullCoverageActuallyRequires.detail: One student-facing task sheet plus one adult-only scoring record per lesson, each with a concrete lesson-specific task, safety notes, a simulation alternative where the task is real-world, remediation, extension, and a verified answer key or authored rubric. The pipeline is already grade-agnostic; the bottleneck is curriculum authoring the source cannot supply.
